provenance.source_title: What Made Nero the Most Evil Boyfriend in Ancient History

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒用指令句把观众放进自己最熟悉的日常场景
examples.expression_mechanism: Picture this 指令 + 第二人称日常动作的零铺垫开场
examples.example_text: Picture this. You open up your phone.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'想象这个+你做了某个日常动作'的两句式在零铺垫下完成沉浸
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景设定；日常动作必须换成目标观众真实的习惯动作

examples.psychological_goal: 用排名悬念抛出'史上之最'承诺，锁住观看动机
examples.expression_mechanism: absolute + undisputed + champion 的三重强化排名句式
examples.example_text: we are going to talk about the absolute undisputed champion of toxic relationships
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'无可争议的冠军'式排名句把人物介绍升级为竞赛悬念
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该排名措辞；最高级承诺必须能被后文案例兑现

examples.psychological_goal: 在正片开始前显式卸载观众的现代默认假设
examples.expression_mechanism: throw away + 观众熟悉的现代概念 的否定式转场
examples.example_text: we have to completely throw away our modern Disney concepts of love
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在进入异时空背景前先点名并丢弃观众的现代默认认知
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该流行文化锚点；被丢弃的概念必须是观众真正持有的

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句现代商业映射为古代制度完成认知重框
examples.expression_mechanism: X was a + 双副词修饰 + 现代商业概念 的定性句
examples.example_text: Marriage was a highly aggressive, deeply cynical corporate merger.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'制度=现代商业概念'的等式句一秒完成跨时代翻译
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该映射措辞；映射必须在逻辑上解释得通

examples.psychological_goal: 把赌注量化成现代金融概念，制造错位笑点与威慑感
examples.expression_mechanism: the ultimate + 现代金融术语 的递进式比喻
examples.example_text: marrying into the imperial family was the ultimate highstakes initial public offering
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在已建立的映射体系上再做一次升级映射，把赌注感推高
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该金融类比；升级映射必须与前一个映射同属一个概念域

examples.psychological_goal: 用'制度性免责'一句话解释危险人格为何永远不被纠正
examples.expression_mechanism: nobody was legally allowed to tell him + 真相 的结构性前提句
examples.example_text: nobody in the entire world was legally allowed to tell him that he was actually completely
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'无人能告诉他真相'句式把人格缺陷升级为结构性恐怖
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该句式措辞；免责机制必须换成目标主题的真实制度

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个现代偶像类比瞬间立起受害者人设与民众爱戴
examples.expression_mechanism: basically the [现代国民偶像] of the [古代世界] 的类比句
examples.example_text: She was basically the Princess Diana of the ancient world.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'古代版某现代偶像'的类比一句立起人物弧光
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该偶像参照；类比对象必须与人物的真实公共形象相符

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代类比拆解荒诞指控，让观众在笑中感到愤怒
examples.expression_mechanism: the ancient equivalent of + 日常小人物场景 的降格类比
examples.example_text: the ancient equivalent of a guy who plays acoustic guitar at a coffee shop
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'古代版某日常小人物'的降格类比暴露指控的荒谬
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景；降格类比必须服务于'指控不成立'的论证

examples.psychological_goal: 让底层小人物以一句羞辱反击权贵，给观众代偿性快感
examples.expression_mechanism: 身体洁净度对比的羞辱式直接引语
examples.example_text: the empress was physically and spiritually cleaner than his own mouth
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让弱者反击台词借用对方自身的肮脏意象完成反杀
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该台词内容；反击必须基于前文建立的忠诚铺垫

examples.psychological_goal: 用婉语黑话包裹致命暴力，形成黑色幽默的震惊收束
examples.expression_mechanism: permanently cancelled + 订阅词汇 的婉语式死亡呈现
examples.example_text: They tied her up, and they permanently cancelled her life subscription.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用现代订阅/账户词汇婉称死亡，让残酷事实带讽刺余味
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该黑话措辞；婉语必须与暴力事实形成反差而非掩盖

examples.psychological_goal: 用赛程式标签宣告案例升级，给观众明确进度感
examples.expression_mechanism: Which brings us to + phase two + 一句角色定性 的阶段转场
examples.example_text: Which brings us to phase two of the nightmare, the new girlfriend.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'进入第X阶段+角色标签'的转场句切换案例并预告升级
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用该句式；阶段标签必须与整体升级阶梯一致

examples.psychological_goal: 用全民熟人的原型台词激活戏剧反讽，让观众预知悲剧
examples.expression_mechanism: 原型人物直接引语（他对我不同/我能改变他）
examples.example_text: Oh, he's different with me. I can fix him.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句观众在现实中听过的台词把历史人物接到现代经验上
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该台词；原型台词必须是目标观众真实听过的版本

examples.psychological_goal: 用'健康选项 vs 极端选项'的对照揭示危险人格的红旗
examples.expression_mechanism: Instead of + 现代健康选项, 主语 + 极端行动 的对照句
examples.example_text: Instead of going to family therapy or setting healthy boundaries, Nero decided to literally assassinate his own mother.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'不去X而是直接Y'的对照句把人格缺陷一次点亮
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该极端对照内容；对照两端必须真实且落差极大

examples.psychological_goal: 用'过度工程 vs 微小动机'的落差制造荒诞笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: 宏大工程描述 + just to avoid + 微小日常动机 的落差句
examples.example_text: He literally built a luxury exploding boat just to avoid having an awkward conversation with his mom about personal space.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先铺陈宏大手段再用'只为避免某件小事'一句引爆笑点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该工程与动机内容；落差必须建立在真实史实上

examples.psychological_goal: 在爆发前用一句比喻判词减速蓄势，把张力拉满
examples.expression_mechanism: had the X of a Y 的名词性比喻判词独立成句
examples.example_text: But Nero had the emotional regulation of a hand grenade.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在高潮前用一句短比喻判词刹车，为随后的爆发蓄能
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比喻；判词比喻必须准确概括前文行为模式

examples.psychological_goal: 把致命后果与荒谬诱因并置，让观众在震惊中体会人格恐怖
examples.expression_mechanism: because + 微不足道诱因 + 严重后果 的因果并置句
examples.example_text: in a matter of seconds because his favorite sports team lost, he completely destroyed the woman he supposedly loved
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把微小诱因与不可逆后果放进同一句，让荒谬感自己说话
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该暴力内容；并置的诱因必须真实到令人不安

examples.psychological_goal: 用'找到了但方向全错'的转折揭示把悬念推向反乌托邦
examples.expression_mechanism: they found someone, but + 否定预期 + 真实答案 的转折句
examples.example_text: they found someone, but it wasn't a woman. It was a young teenage boy
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'找到但不对'的转折结构把搜寻悬念升级为身份恐怖
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该转折内容；转折必须重新定义前文建立的目标

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代亚文化词汇为受害者余生定性，完成身份抹除的认知反转
examples.expression_mechanism: cosplaying as the ghost of + 被害者 的现代概念定性
examples.example_text: cosplaying as the ghost of the woman his new husband had murdered
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用现代行为词汇为古代受害处境定性，一句话完成同情与战栗
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该措辞；定性词必须让荒诞与残酷同时成立

examples.psychological_goal: 用极致反差的画面呈现荒诞顶点，制造哭笑不得的震撼
examples.expression_mechanism: 权力描述铺垫 + 反向角色动作 的画面句
examples.example_text: walked down the aisle dressed as a submissive bride.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先堆叠身份量级再用一个反向动作画面完成荒诞封顶
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该画面内容；反差画面必须有前文权力铺垫支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用'至少你不会…'的感恩反转让观众带着释然离场
examples.expression_mechanism: X might be a nightmare, but at least + 观众不会遭遇的极端后果 的让步反转句
examples.example_text: Modern dating might be a nightmare, but at least your breakup won't trigger a federal investigation and a forced gender reassignment.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾让步反转结构：承认观众的烦恼，再用极端对照完成安慰
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该结尾措辞；对照后果必须是全片已兑现过的案例
